title: Ingest Markdown PRDs from project task directories
description: Support controlled ingestion of Markdown PRDs such as ez4ielts tasks/prd-*.md. The ingestor must parse frontmatter, avoid duplicate active tasks, respect dependencies, and not assume the old ez4ielts JSON-only watch pattern.

userStories.title: Parse Markdown PRDs with frontmatter safely
userStories.description: Extract id, title, status, priority, dependencies, declared surfaces, and acceptance criteria from Markdown PRDs without treating prose-only strategy docs as implementation tasks by default.
acceptanceCriteria: Markdown PRDs with valid frontmatter can be enqueued by start and batch-start.
Umbrella or strategy PRDs can be marked non-executable and are skipped by auto-ingest.
Missing title or invalid dependency metadata fails intake with a clear message.

userStories.title: Watch configured task directories
userStories.description: Allow managers to watch project-specific task globs such as tasks/prd-*.md without hardcoding ez4ielts JSON names.
acceptanceCriteria: Config can declare watched PRD globs per Ralph home.
Auto-ingest dedupes by repo and PRD id.
Existing JSON PRD ingestion behavior remains compatible.

userStories.title: Cover Markdown ingestion with regression tests
userStories.description: Add tests for new files, modified invalid files, dependency extraction, duplicate suppression, and non-executable strategy documents.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests cover Markdown and JSON PRD intake paths.
Queue state records the immutable PRD source hash for Markdown PRDs.
